description: A restrained vintage lounge/cabaret instrumental lobby bed: lightly wistful, gently comic, warm, unobtrusive and suitable under dialogue.
loop_reason: Continuous unobtrusive background music under the reception dialogue.
trigger: Start at the beginning of the reception scene.
stop_condition: Fade or stop at the scene transition.
prompt: Create a 30-second seamless loop of restrained vintage hotel lobby lounge music: muted piano, soft upright bass, brushed percussion and faint clarinet or accordion. Lightly wistful and gently comic, low-key and unobtrusive under dialogue. Keep the same moderate loudness, texture, tempo and instrumentation from the very first sample to the very last. Begin already in the established musical texture; do not start with a hit, transient or fade-in. Do not fade out, resolve, cadence, stop or become quieter at the end. End on a sustained part of the same texture that can connect directly back to the opening. No vocals, no abrupt accents, no intro, no outro. Seamless looping game audio, maintain a consistent texture and energy, avoid a distinct ending, abrupt fade, or new transient at the end; the audio will be repeated.

technical_inspection.note: Boundary metrics do not establish a perceptually seamless loop; audition repeated playback.
